caption: The drawing depicts a square piece of fabric in a yellow ochre color, folded once horizontally and laid flat on a neutral, lightly textured background. The fabric has a subtle, semi-transparent texture with a fringe along its left and bottom edges. Along the left and lower edges of the fabric, there are large, stylized leaf motifs in white, with internal linear patterns representing leaf veins. There are two additional smaller, similar motifs in the central upper right portion of the fabric. The image is detailed to show the weave and the translucency of the fabric, and the artist’s signature “IV LUBRANO” appears at the bottom right of the drawing, just below the fabric.
title: Printed Textiles
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
